# Multiply testdata

- `route_state_schema9.json`: a hand-written schema-9 route document used for
  serde-compatibility tests (deny-unknown-fields decode, validate, round-trip).
  It was NOT generated by the Rust worker (cargo was unavailable in this
  environment); the field names, spellings (`debtAmountSf`, `healthFactorPpm`,
  `currentOperationId`), tagged-`kind` position, and the always-present
  `currentOperationId: null` mirror the Rust serde contract reviewed in
  `crates/loyal-yield-store/src/fleet_orchestration/multiply.rs`. The public
  keys are deliberate placeholders except where a test derives real PDAs.
